resources.string: %1$d\n\nAuto close the notification popup after this many seconds. Pressing any button will stop the timer until the next notification. Set to 0 to disable.
Display MessagingStyle conversation bodies oldest-first. When disabled, newest messages are shown first to reduce scrolling.
Skip watch alerts while phone is unlocked
When enabled, notifications received while the phone is unlocked are not sent to the watch and do not open the watch app.
When enabled, notifications wait until the watch returns to a watchface before opening Notification Sync.
If phone received any non-muted notifications during watch disconnect, it will show them on the watch after it reconnects
